node.name: Spellbreaker
node.description: KEYSTONE: Your melee hits on a target that is casting have a 40% chance to break the cast and make it cast 25% slower for 3 seconds.

node.name: Charge
node.description: KEYSTONE: Your first melee hit on a target you haven't hit for 8 seconds deals 30% more damage and stuns it for 1 second (a stun at most once every 6 seconds).

node.name: Hamstring
node.description: KEYSTONE: Your melee hits have a 30% chance to slow the target by 30% for 3 seconds.

node.name: Bloodthirst
node.description: KEYSTONE: Each kill restores 25% of your maximum HP and CP.

node.name: Executioner's Instinct
node.description: KEYSTONE: Your melee attacks and physical skills deal 40% more damage to targets below 30% HP.

node.name: Arcane Bulwark
node.description: KEYSTONE: You take 35% less damage from area skills.

node.name: Juggernaut
node.description: KEYSTONE: You can't be slowed or rooted, and you move 10 faster in heavy armour.

node.name: Last Stand
node.description: KEYSTONE: When your HP falls below 30%, you take no damage for 6 seconds and deal 20% more damage (P.Atk and M.Atk) meanwhile. At most once every 2 minutes.

node.name: Pinning Shot
node.description: KEYSTONE: Your bow and crossbow hits have a 20% chance to pin the target in place for 2 seconds (at most once every 6 seconds).

node.name: Kite Step
node.description: KEYSTONE: When you are hit in melee range, you gain +25 Speed for 3 seconds (at most once every 8 seconds).

node.name: Assassin's Mark
node.description: KEYSTONE: Your melee attacks and skills deal 35% more damage from behind the target.

node.name: Blade Dance
node.description: KEYSTONE: Your melee hits have a 25% chance to give you +15% Attack Speed and +10% P.Atk for 5 seconds.

node.name: Sweeping Momentum
node.description: KEYSTONE: Your polearm attacks deal 10% more damage for each other fighter within 150 of your target, up to 30%.
